d: Bangladesh ki purv pradhanmantri shekh hasina ne kaha ki vah 16 disanbar ko bharat se apne desh lautengi. agast 2024 men satta se bedkhal hone ke bad se vah bharat men rah rahi hain. bangladesh men 16 disanbar ke din vijay divas manaya jata hai. nyuz ejensi esosieted pres (epi) ke mutabiq, mangalvar ko apni vapsi ki tarikh batate hue shekh hasina ne bangladesh ke maujuda pradhanmantri tariq rahman se neshnal eyarlain ke zarie unki vapsi ka intzam karne ki apil ki. bangladesh men videsh mamlon ke rajy mantri humayun kabir ne kaha hai ki hasina ko agar vapas aana hai to unhen hathakri…
